question: Which player led India at the women's Hockey Asia Cup in Muscat, which was held in January 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Savita Punia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Savita Punia** led the **Indian women's hockey team** in the **Asia Cup** held in **Muscat** in **January 2022.**
 
• Savita Punia is a** goalkeeper **and has been a vital member of the** Indian women's hockey team** for many years.
 
• She has represented India in several international tournaments and has won **several accolades** for her performance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Navneet Kaur** is a** forward player** and has also been a part of the Indian women's hockey team for many years.

 
 
• She has** 100 international caps** to her credit.
 
 
 
• **Rani Rampal** is a forward player and has been the captain of the Indian **women's hockey team** for several years.
 
 
• She was the **youngest player **on the national team that competed in the **2010 World Cup**, having turned **15 years old.**
 
 
 
• **Susmita Patil **is **not** a part of the Indian women's hockey team and has not represented India in any international tournament.
